As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) returns to Apple TV tomorrow, with Apple Maps, Apple Sports, Apple Fitness+ and other platforms simultaneously rolling out a range of related features. Details are as follows.

MLS Returns to Apple TV

Apple today gave a special preview of the return of Apple League Soccer, with six matches to be played over the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs Toronto FC (7:30 p.m. ET)
  • Chicago Fire vs Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 p.m. ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs Sporting Kansas City (8:30 p.m. ET)
  • Seattle Sounders vs Portland Timbers (10:30 p.m. ET)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs Atlanta United FC (8:10 p.m. ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs Los Angeles FC (10:15 p.m. ET)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a host of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a brand-new Time to Walk audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The new episode is hosted by German football legend Thomas Müller, who will "reflect on the efforts he made before fame, and share how he embraced the challenges of major life changes."

Apple Music will also debut a number of exclusive playlists curated by star players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake, Evander da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati, as well as themed playlists from New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, Orlando City SC and other teams from the Eastern and Western Conferences.

On Apple Maps, the company will roll out "bespoke matchday guides produced by MLS clubs, along with city tours personally recommended by players, helping users discover local restaurants suited for match viewing, explore city hotspots and gain in-depth knowledge about stadiums."

Users relying on the Apple Sports app can stay up to date with the latest league developments, including live scores, standings, real-time match updates, line-ups and team stats.

Lastly, Apple stated:

MLS matches are available free of charge to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions, with Apple also providing exclusive content and viewing access to all cup competitions and playoffs throughout the season.

To learn more about Apple's MLS return highlights, please visit this link.

Apple TV is priced at US$12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed to via the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a wide range of hit series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
